target_buyer_1.address: Ashtabula River at historic Bridge Street, Ashtabula, OH
target_buyer_1.why_top_candidate: Premier yacht club founded in 1924 with 150+ members and 125 docks. Located in protected harbor on Ashtabula River, 1/2 mile south of Lake Erie lighthouse. Recently invested in harbor infrastructure including 35-ton travel lift and 600+ feet of bulkhead replacement. Reputation for friendliness, great sail/racing program. Part of newly renovated Ashtabula Harbor historic district with world-class restaurants, live music, wineries nearby.

target_buyer_2.why_top_candidate: Official economic development entity established 1988 by county commissioners. Manages harbor infrastructure, industrial parks, and port facilities. Strategic location: 59% of US/Canadian populations within 600 miles. Critical role in North Bend Industrial Park, Coffee Creek Industrial Park, and former First Energy Plant C acquisition. Primary stakeholder for harbor-wide technology initiatives with legitimacy and potential funding.
